subject: investor_deck_v1_archived
text: Archived copy of investor deck v1.0 saved to shared drive on April 10. Contains the same 18,000 South Yard capacity claim as the original.

subject: investor_deck_backup
text: Backup copy of investor deck found in Maya Chen's personal folder, dated May 1. Identical 18,000 claim.

subject: executive_summary
text: Executive summary for the city council presentation references '18,000-person South Yard capacity' citing the February planning meeting recap.

subject: local_newspaper
text: Local newspaper article: 'Nightglass Festival expects to draw 18,000 to the former Harborworks shipyard's South Yard.'

subject: Jules_Carter
text: Jules Carter's safety briefing to the venue team references the 18,000 figure: 'Our plans accommodate up to 18,000 in the South Yard.'

subject: ai_summary
text: AI-generated planning summary: 'Based on available documentation, the South Yard capacity is 18,000. This figure appears across multiple independent sources including the investor deck, vendor briefings, and safety training materials.'

subject: search_result
text: Internal knowledge base search for 'South Yard capacity' returns 14 documents citing 18,000 and only 1 document showing 12,400.

subject: Rowan_Pierce
text: Rowan's June talking points for sponsor calls still reference 18,000 capacity. He has not seen the fire permit correction.

subject: fire_permit
text: Fire permit #FP-2026-0847 issued March 20 by City Fire Department establishes the South Yard maximum occupancy at 12,400 persons based on egress analysis and hydrant coverage.

subject: Omar_Velasquez
text: Omar Velasquez confirmed receipt of fire permit FP-2026-0847 and noted the 12,400 limit to Maya Chen in an email: 'This is the controlling number — all plans must use 12,400, not the earlier estimates.'

subject: Maya_Chen
text: Maya Chen updated the site operations plan to reflect the 12,400 fire permit limit. However, she did not propagate this correction to the ticket platform or marketing materials.

subject: fire_department
text: City Fire Department inspection note confirms South Yard occupancy limit of 12,400, consistent with permit FP-2026-0847.

subject: Jules_Carter
text: Jules Carter discovered the discrepancy between the 18,000 figure in planning documents and the 12,400 fire permit limit while reviewing emergency evacuation times.

subject: Jules_Carter
text: Jules Carter sent an urgent email to Rowan Pierce: 'Our planning docs say 18,000 but the fire permit caps us at 12,400. We need to correct all downstream documents immediately.'

subject: ticket_platform
text: Ticket platform capacity updated to 12,400 on June 1 after Jules Carter's discovery. Approximately 2,000 excess tickets had already been allocated but not yet sold.

subject: Blue_Lantern_Security
text: Blue Lantern Security revised staffing plan from 90 to 62 guards based on the corrected 12,400 capacity (1 guard per 200 attendees).

subject: unnamed_staff
text: At a casual lunch conversation, a staff member mentioned they heard the fire marshal 'signed off on our numbers' — referring ambiguously to the fire safety review process.

subject: vendor_coordinator
text: Vendor coordinator told incoming contractors: 'The fire marshal signed off on 18,000 for the South Yard, so we're good to go.'

subject: safety_handbook
text: Safety handbook revision dated April 10 states: 'South Yard capacity of 18,000 has been approved by the fire marshal's office.' This is false — the fire permit actually sets 12,400.

subject: training_session
text: New volunteer training session on May 1 includes the claim: 'The fire marshal has officially approved our 18,000-person capacity for the South Yard.' No one questions this.

subject: Harborworks_Utilities
text: Harborworks Utilities team measured water pressure at the east hydrant loop at 35 PSI, well below the required 65 PSI minimum for fire safety compliance.

subject: fire_department
text: City Fire Department conducted an independent flow test on east loop hydrants during a routine inspection. Flow rate measured at 450 GPM vs. required 750 GPM.

subject: Blue_Lantern_Security
text: Blue Lantern Security reported poor hydrant flow during an emergency drill. Guard noted: 'The east side hydrant barely produced a stream — completely inadequate for crowd-density firefighting.'

subject: plumber_contractor
text: Licensed plumber contracted for the festival's temporary facilities found significant corrosion in the east hydrant supply line during unrelated work.

subject: Maya_Chen
text: Maya Chen noticed unusually low water pressure in the east building's restroom and tested multiple faucets, all showing weak flow. She independently flagged this to the venue manager.

subject: east_hydrant_loop
text: Five independent observations on August 11 from different parties all confirm abnormally low water pressure in the east hydrant loop: Harborworks Utilities (35 PSI), Fire Department (450 GPM), Blue Lantern Security (drill failure), plumber (corrosion), and Maya Chen (faucet test).

subject: Harborworks_Utilities
text: Harborworks Utilities diagnosed the root cause: a corroded main supply valve feeding the east hydrant loop had been restricting flow for months.

subject: east_hydrant_loop
text: East hydrant loop supply valve replaced August 20. Post-repair pressure measured at 72 PSI, meeting fire safety requirements.

subject: vendor_ingress
text: Initial site operations plan designates Gate C as the primary vendor ingress point for all contractor deliveries and personnel.

subject: vendor_map
text: Printed vendor site map distributed in March shows Gate C as vendor ingress with directional arrows and parking assignments.

subject: loading_schedule
text: Master loading schedule for vendor deliveries references Gate C as the drop-off point for all days of the festival.

subject: Blue_Lantern_Security
text: Blue Lantern Security's checkpoint assignment roster lists Gate C as the vendor checkpoint with dedicated credential verification staffing.

subject: contractor_FAQ
text: Contractor FAQ document updated June 15 directs all vendors to Gate C for ingress. 'Q: Where do I enter? A: All vendor personnel enter through Gate C.'

subject: vendor_ingress
text: Vendor ingress reassigned from Gate C to Gate F on July 31 due to construction blocking the Gate C access road. Maya Chen issued the change notice.

subject: Maya_Chen
text: Maya Chen emailed all registered vendors: 'Effective immediately, vendor ingress has moved from Gate C to Gate F. Please update your GPS and arrival instructions.'

subject: updated_site_map
text: Updated digital site map now shows Gate F as vendor ingress. Only posted to the vendor portal; printed maps still show Gate C.

subject: late_arriving_vendor
text: A vendor arriving August 5 went to Gate C per their printed map, found it blocked, and had to call Maya Chen to get redirected to Gate F.

subject: internal_search
text: Searching the festival document system for 'vendor gate' returns 15 documents referencing Gate C and only 3 referencing Gate F.

subject: Nightglass_Festival_LLC
text: Nightglass Festival LLC was founded by Rowan Pierce in November 2025 as a three-day arts and music festival.

subject: Harborworks_Shipyard
text: The former Harborworks Shipyard was selected as the Nightglass Festival venue. The South Yard is the primary outdoor stage field.

subject: Maya_Chen
text: Maya Chen was hired as site operations director, responsible for all venue logistics, layout, and day-of operations.

subject: Jules_Carter
text: Jules Carter was hired as safety coordinator, responsible for emergency planning, fire safety compliance, and crowd management protocols.

subject: Omar_Velasquez
text: Omar Velasquez serves as the fire marshal liaison, coordinating between the festival and the City Fire Department on all permit and inspection matters.

subject: Blue_Lantern_Security
text: Blue Lantern Security contracted to provide all security services for Nightglass Festival including access control, crowd management, and emergency response.

subject: South_Yard
text: The South Yard is an open field measuring approximately 120m x 85m, previously used as a ship assembly staging area at the Harborworks Shipyard.

subject: festival_dates
text: Nightglass Festival is scheduled for September 12-14, 2026 at the Harborworks Shipyard.

subject: site_permit_application
text: Festival's site permit application to the city listed expected attendance as 18,000 for the South Yard, before the fire safety review was completed.

subject: insurance_policy
text: Festival liability insurance policy underwritten for up to 18,000 attendees in the South Yard. Premium calculated on this figure.

subject: food_vendor_contract
text: Food vendor contracts specify preparation for 18,000 meal servings per day based on the planning capacity figure.

subject: porta_potty_order
text: Portable restroom order placed for 90 units based on the 18,000 capacity figure (1 per 200 attendees per health code).

subject: Rowan_Pierce
text: Rowan Pierce updated the investor deck to show 12,400 capacity. He added a note: 'Corrected per fire permit FP-2026-0847. Previous versions showed 18,000 in error.'

subject: safety_handbook
text: Safety handbook corrected to show 12,400 capacity. The fire marshal sign-off rumor was also removed from this edition.

subject: Maya_Chen
text: Maya Chen's document audit on July 1 found 8 planning documents still showing the 18,000 figure, including the insurance policy, food contracts, and the porta-potty order.

subject: insurance_policy
text: As of August 1, the festival's liability insurance policy still covers 18,000 attendees. The insurance broker has not been notified of the correction.

subject: food_vendor_contracts
text: Food vendor contracts still specify preparation for 18,000 servings. Maya has flagged this for renegotiation but it has not been completed.

subject: local_newspaper_article
text: The April 20 newspaper article claiming 18,000 capacity was never corrected or retracted. It remains the top search result for 'Nightglass Festival capacity.'

subject: Rowan_Pierce
text: Rowan expressed frustration at the capacity reduction: 'We've been telling sponsors 18,000 for months. A 31% drop in capacity changes our entire revenue model.'

subject: Omar_Velasquez
text: Omar Velasquez stressed to the team: 'The fire permit limit is non-negotiable. The fire department can shut us down on the spot if we exceed 12,400 in the South Yard.'

subject: Rowan_Pierce
text: Rowan asked Omar if the fire permit could be amended to increase the limit. Omar explained the 12,400 was based on physical egress constraints, not arbitrary, and amendment was unlikely.

subject: sponsor_presentation
text: A sponsor presentation deck created by a junior marketing associate on July 15 still uses the 18,000 figure, having been based on the uncorrected template.

subject: intern
text: A planning intern asked during a meeting: 'I was reviewing the fire permit and it says 12,400, but all our plans say 18,000. Which is right?' The question was deflected with 'we'll look into it.'

subject: vendor_packet_copy
text: Second printing of vendor briefing packet from June 1 is identical to the March version, still showing 18,000 capacity.

subject: shared_drive_summary
text: Auto-generated summary document on the shared drive compiles all capacity references and presents 18,000 as the 'consensus capacity' based on document frequency.

subject: volunteer_handbook
text: Volunteer handbook printed June 1 directs vendors to Gate C. The handbook was never reprinted after the July 31 gate change.

subject: GPS_directions
text: Default GPS coordinates for 'Nightglass Festival vendor entrance' still route to Gate C's location.

subject: South_Yard
text: Current authorized South Yard capacity is 12,400 per fire permit FP-2026-0847. All corrected planning documents reflect this figure.

subject: vendor_ingress
text: Current vendor ingress point is Gate F, effective since July 31. Gate C is physically blocked by construction.

subject: east_hydrant_loop
text: East hydrant loop water pressure is currently 72 PSI, meeting fire safety requirements after the August 20 valve replacement.

subject: chatbot_response
text: Internal chatbot asked 'What is the South Yard capacity?' responds: 'Based on 14 sources, the South Yard capacity is 18,000. Sources include the investor deck, safety manual, vendor packet, and city council presentation.'

subject: correct_answer
text: The fire permit showing 12,400 appears as result #15 in the internal search for 'South Yard capacity,' buried under 14 documents citing 18,000.

subject: jules_email_forward
text: Jules Carter's correction email was forwarded to the full team on July 1 by Maya Chen, but by then many documents had already been printed or distributed.

subject: parking_plan
text: Festival parking plan allocates 4,500 vehicle spaces based on the 18,000 capacity figure (assuming 4 people per car average).

subject: emergency_egress_plan
text: Emergency egress plan designs evacuation routes and assembly points for 18,000 people. Evacuation time estimate: 22 minutes to clear the South Yard.

subject: sound_engineer
text: Sound system design specifies PA coverage for 18,000-person crowd density across the South Yard's 120m x 85m footprint.

subject: medical_plan
text: Festival medical plan provisions 6 first aid stations and 2 ambulances based on 18,000 expected attendees (1 station per 3,000 per health department guidelines).

subject: waste_management
text: Waste management contract specifies trash and recycling capacity for 18,000 attendees over three days.

subject: water_distribution
text: Drinking water distribution plan provides for 36,000 bottles (2 per person) based on 18,000 capacity.

subject: wifi_network
text: Festival WiFi network designed to handle 18,000 simultaneous device connections across the South Yard.

subject: crowd_density_analysis
text: Crowd density analysis report calculates 1.76 persons per square meter at 18,000 capacity — borderline uncomfortable but within safety guidelines.

subject: crowd_density_recalculated
text: Recalculated crowd density at 12,400 capacity: 1.21 persons per square meter, well within comfort guidelines.

subject: emergency_egress_plan
text: Emergency egress plan revised for 12,400 occupancy. New evacuation time estimate: 15 minutes to clear the South Yard.

subject: parking_plan
text: Parking plan still allocates 4,500 spaces based on the uncorrected 18,000 figure. At 12,400, only 3,100 spaces are needed.

subject: sound_system
text: Sound system remains configured for 18,000-person coverage. While not harmful, it represents wasted budget.

subject: medical_plan
text: Medical plan has not been revised. Still provisions 6 first aid stations for 18,000 — at 12,400, 4 stations would suffice per guidelines.

subject: waste_management_contract
text: Waste management contract has not been renegotiated to reflect 12,400 capacity.

subject: water_distribution_plan
text: Water distribution plan still provisions 36,000 bottles. At 12,400 capacity, 24,800 would be appropriate.

subject: delivery_truck_instructions
text: Delivery truck routing instructions sent to all food vendors specify Gate C entry with a left turn past Warehouse 7.

subject: emergency_vehicle_access
text: Emergency vehicle access plan routes ambulances through Gate C for fastest South Yard access.

subject: site_orientation_video
text: Vendor site orientation video walks through Gate C as the primary vendor entrance. The video was posted to YouTube and has 342 views.

subject: construction_fence
text: Construction fencing installed across the Gate C access road. Physical barrier prevents any vehicle from using Gate C.

subject: Blue_Lantern_Security
text: Blue Lantern Security relocated vendor checkpoint from Gate C to Gate F. New badge verification station set up with portable booth.

subject: loading_schedule_v2
text: Updated loading schedule v2 references Gate F for all vendor deliveries during the festival.

subject: Harborworks_Utilities
text: Harborworks Utilities tested all four hydrants on the east loop. Results: H-1: 32 PSI, H-2: 35 PSI, H-3: 38 PSI, H-4: 30 PSI. All below the 65 PSI minimum.

subject: fire_department
text: Fire Department documented their flow test methodology: hydrant H-2 opened full, Pitot gauge reading, timed to 2-minute steady state. Flow rate 450 GPM vs 750 GPM required.

subject: security_drill_footage
text: Security drill video footage shows visibly weak flow from the east hydrant, barely reaching 3 meters horizontal distance. Guard on camera: 'This is nowhere near adequate.'

subject: plumber_contractor
text: Plumber photographed a heavily corroded section of the east supply line where it passes under the loading dock. Corrosion reduced the interior diameter by approximately 40%.

subject: Maya_Chen
text: Maya Chen measured the east building restroom faucet flow at approximately 0.5 GPM using a timed container fill, well below the expected 2.2 GPM.

subject: water_pressure_report
text: Jules Carter compiled all five independent water pressure observations into a single report for the fire department, noting that the observations came from completely separate parties and contexts.

subject: sponsor_briefing
text: During a sponsor briefing, Rowan mentioned 'the fire marshal has approved our capacity numbers' — he was repeating what he'd heard from the vendor coordinator, not from any official source.

subject: sponsor_email
text: Email to potential sponsors states: 'Our 18,000-person capacity has been approved by the local fire marshal, ensuring full regulatory compliance.'

subject: Omar_Velasquez
text: When asked directly, Omar Velasquez stated: 'I never told anyone the fire marshal approved 18,000. The permit says 12,400 and I communicated that clearly to Maya in March.'

subject: Harborworks_Shipyard
text: Harborworks Shipyard was decommissioned in 2024 after 47 years of operation. The site was rezoned for mixed commercial use.

subject: South_Yard
text: The South Yard retains its industrial paving with storm drainage infrastructure from its shipyard era. The surface can support vehicle traffic for load-in.

subject: Harborworks_Utilities
text: Harborworks Utilities was retained to manage venue utility infrastructure during the festival period, leveraging their knowledge of the shipyard's systems.

subject: festival_budget
text: Nightglass Festival total production budget is $1.8 million, covering talent, infrastructure, security, marketing, and operations.

subject: lineup
text: Nightglass Festival lineup features three headlining acts performing on the South Yard main stage across three evenings.

subject: fire_department
text: Fire Department reinspection on August 15 confirmed: South Yard capacity remains 12,400 per permit. East hydrant loop pressure issue noted and flagged for repair before festival.

subject: fire_department
text: Fire Department issued conditional approval for the festival: 'Event may proceed provided east hydrant loop pressure is restored to 65 PSI minimum before September 10.'

subject: Jules_Carter
text: Jules calculated that if 18,000 tickets had been sold at the original capacity, the festival would have exceeded the fire permit by 5,600 people — a 45% overshoot that could have resulted in criminal liability.

subject: festival_website
text: Festival website FAQ still answers 'How many people attend?' with '18,000 music fans fill the South Yard each day.'

subject: podcast_interview
text: In a July 10 podcast interview, Rowan stated: 'We're expecting up to 18,000 in the South Yard.' He was using stale talking points and had forgotten to update them after the June correction.

subject: third_party_review_site
text: Third-party event review site lists Nightglass Festival capacity as 18,000, sourced from the festival's public materials.

subject: city_tourism_board
text: City tourism board website promotes Nightglass as 'an 18,000-person music festival at the historic Harborworks Shipyard.' They sourced this from the city council presentation.

subject: Maya_Chen
text: Maya sent a blanket correction email to all vendor contacts: 'Please note that the South Yard capacity has been revised to 12,400 per fire safety requirements. Previous figures of 18,000 are no longer valid.'

subject: ticket_platform
text: Ticket platform now displays a correction banner: 'South Yard capacity: 12,400 (revised from earlier estimate).'

subject: social_media_correction
text: Festival social media posted a correction: 'Update: South Yard capacity is 12,400. Our earlier posts showing 18,000 were incorrect.' The correction post received only 45 likes vs 800+ on the original.

subject: Maya_Chen
text: Maya Chen initially believed the 18,000 figure had been properly vetted: 'I assumed someone had validated the capacity with the fire department before it went into the concept plan.'

subject: Maya_Chen
text: Maya discovered that no one had validated the 18,000 figure against any fire safety calculation: 'The concept plan just put in a number and everyone downstream treated it as gospel.'

subject: Jules_Carter
text: Jules Carter initially assumed the 18,000 figure in the safety training was derived from fire code calculations: 'I trusted that the number in the training materials had been through proper review.'

subject: vendor_packet_email_attachment
text: Email attachment version of the vendor briefing packet is byte-for-byte identical to the printed version, both showing 18,000.

subject: slide_deck_screenshots
text: Screenshots of the investor deck slides showing 18,000 were shared in the team Slack channel and pinned as reference.

subject: meeting_notes_may15
text: Meeting notes from May 15 reference '18,000 (established capacity)' without citation, treating it as an accepted institutional fact.

subject: budget_spreadsheet
text: Revenue projection spreadsheet calculates gross ticket revenue based on 18,000 GA tickets at $85 each = $1,530,000.

subject: revised_revenue_projection
text: Revised revenue projection based on 12,400 tickets: $1,054,000 gross, a $476,000 reduction from the original projection.

subject: North_Yard
text: The North Yard (secondary stage area) has its own capacity of 4,200 under a separate fire permit. The 12,400 South Yard limit applies only to the South Yard.

subject: total_festival_capacity
text: One planning document erroneously states the total festival capacity as 18,000, confusing the South Yard concept figure with the total site capacity.

subject: total_festival_capacity
text: Actual total festival site capacity: 12,400 (South Yard) + 4,200 (North Yard) = 16,600 total across both areas.

subject: Jules_Carter
text: Jules discovered the capacity discrepancy at approximately 2 PM on May 20 while calculating evacuation clearance times for the emergency management plan.

subject: Jules_Carter
text: Jules called the City Fire Department to verify the permit: they confirmed 12,400 is the hard cap for the South Yard with no variance provision.

subject: Jules_Carter
text: Jules called an emergency meeting with Rowan, Maya, and Omar on May 21 to discuss the capacity discrepancy and plan corrections.

subject: quarterly_report
text: Q2 quarterly report to investors includes '18,000 South Yard capacity' in its executive summary. The report was finalized before the correction reached the finance team.

subject: corrected_quarterly_supplement
text: A corrective supplement to the Q2 report was issued July 30: 'Amendment: South Yard capacity is 12,400 per fire permit, not 18,000 as previously stated.'

subject: concept_plan_author
text: The concept plan's author later admitted: 'I estimated 18,000 based on the South Yard's square footage and a rough rule of thumb. I didn't realize it would be treated as an official capacity figure.'

subject: Rowan_Pierce
text: Rowan admitted: 'I never verified the 18,000 number against any fire safety standard. When I saw it in the spreadsheet, I assumed it had been calculated properly.'

subject: shuttle_service
text: Festival shuttle service contract specifies capacity for 18,000 daily round trips between parking overflow and the venue.

subject: crowd_control_barriers
text: Crowd control barrier order: 240 steel barriers configured for crowd channeling based on 18,000-person flow modeling.

subject: porta_potty_placement_map
text: Placement map for 90 portable restrooms positions them based on 18,000-person crowd density patterns.

subject: press_release
text: Official press release: 'Nightglass Festival announces 18,000-capacity main stage event at historic Harborworks Shipyard, September 12-14.'

subject: construction_notice
text: Construction company posted notice July 25 that heavy equipment staging would block the Gate C access road starting July 30. Maya began planning the transition to Gate F.

subject: signage
text: New directional signage installed at Gate F and along the approach road. Signs read 'VENDORS → GATE F' with Nightglass Festival branding.

subject: second_vendor
text: Second vendor in a week arrived at the now-blocked Gate C. Called the festival hotline confused: 'All my paperwork says Gate C but there's a construction fence.'

subject: Harborworks_Utilities
text: Harborworks Utilities estimated the valve corrosion developed over 3-5 years from salt water exposure common in shipyard infrastructure.

subject: fire_department
text: Fire Department independently verified the pressure restoration: 72 PSI at H-1, 70 PSI at H-2, 74 PSI at H-3, 71 PSI at H-4. All above 65 PSI minimum.

subject: Maya_Chen
text: Maya's July 1 audit breakdown: insurance policy (18K), food contracts (18K), porta-potty order (18K), waste contract (18K), water plan (18K), parking plan (18K), sound spec (18K), medical plan (18K). All still uncorrected.

subject: Maya_Chen
text: Maya's August 15 follow-up audit: insurance policy, medical plan, parking plan, waste contract, and water distribution plan still show 18,000. Food contracts and porta-potty order were renegotiated.

subject: food_vendor_contracts
text: Food vendor contracts renegotiated to 12,400 servings per day. Two vendors objected but eventually agreed to revised terms.

subject: porta_potty_order
text: Portable restroom order reduced from 90 to 62 units based on corrected 12,400 capacity.

subject: new_hire_onboarding
text: A new operations hire's onboarding deck includes a slide stating 'South Yard capacity: 18,000' — sourced from the shared drive where the archived deck copies still reside.

subject: city_council_minutes
text: City council meeting minutes from April record the 18,000 figure as presented. Official government minutes are not typically corrected after the fact.

subject: google_knowledge_panel
text: Google's knowledge panel for 'Nightglass Festival' shows '18,000 capacity' sourced from the newspaper article and tourism board website.

subject: Rowan_Pierce
text: In February, Rowan was fully confident in the 18,000 figure: 'This is a world-class venue and 18,000 is exactly the scale we need to be competitive.'

subject: Rowan_Pierce
text: By mid-June, Rowan had accepted the 12,400 limit: 'It changes our business model, but we can't argue with the fire department. Let's make 12,400 work.'
